title: Elderly Woman in Plaid Fringe Shawl in Garden, 1930s Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate full-length outdoor portrait of an elderly matriarch standing on a rustic wooden plank or walkway in a residential backyard. She smiles warmly at the camera with her hands gently clasped in front of her, bundled up against the cool air in a thick plaid wool shawl with fringe wrapped over a dark, ankle-length dress. To her right is the side of a wooden clapboard house or porch, with dormant trees, a clothesline, and overgrown garden beds filling the background. The reverse side features black construction paper album remnants at the corners and a small blue developer stamp.
